title: 第82章 马主任使坏

第82章 马主任使坏-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

三天后，出事了。

上午十点多，林国强正在后厨备菜，刘强骑着自行车来了，脸色不太好看。

他下了车，把林国强拉到一边，低声说：“国强，供销社那边有人吃了你家卤味，闹肚子了。

三个人，上吐下泻，现在在卫生院躺着。”

林国强手里的刀停了。

“我去看看。”

供销社门口已经围了一圈人。

卤味柜台关着，王主任站在旁边，脸色铁青。

看见林国强，他劈头就问：“林老板，到底是怎么回事？三个人吃了你家卤味进医院了！”

林国强没急着辩解，走到柜台前，掀开纱布看了看卤味，闻了闻。

然后拿起一块卤豆干，掰开，仔细看了看断面。

“王主任，这卤味不对。”

“哪里不对？”

“我的卤味，颜色红亮，是糖色炒出来的，这个颜色发暗，还有股怪味。”

林国强把豆干递给他，“你闻闻。”

王主任接过来闻了闻，脸色变了。

确实有股说不出的味道，酸不拉几的，不像正常卤味。

“这批货不是我送的。”

林国强看着王主任，“我每天早上让赵志军送货，送多少，卖多少，都有单子。

今天的单子在这儿。”

他从兜里掏出一张纸，上面写着：卤猪蹄四十个，卤豆干六十块，卤鸡腿三十个。

柜台里的卤味，数量对不上。

多了好几样。

“有人往我货里掺了东西。”

林国强声音不大，但周围的人都听见了。

王主任脑门上的汗下来了。

供销社的柜台，有人往里掺东西，这事大了。

“报警。”林国强说。

刘强带队来的。

三个人，穿了警服，把柜台围了，把剩下的卤味全部取样带走。

围观的人越来越多，议论纷纷。

调查比想象中快。

卫生院那边出了结果，三个人是吃了变质食物导致的食物中毒，问题出在一批卤豆干上。

那批卤豆干里有几块明显发黏，闻着有馊味，跟林国强正常供货的卤味完全不一样。

谁放的？

刘强把当天接触过柜台的人都问了一遍。

售货员、搬运工、打扫卫生的。

问到最后，售货员老周吞吞吐吐地说，上午马副主任来过。

Three days later, something happened.

At around ten o'clock in the morning, Lin Guoqiang was preparing food in the back kitchen. Liu Qiang came on a bicycle with a bad look on his face.

He got out of the car, pulled Lin Guoqiang aside, and whispered: "Guoqiang, someone at the supply and marketing cooperative ate your braised food and got a stomachache.

Three people, suffering from vomiting and diarrhea, are now lying in the health center."

The knife in Lin Guoqiang's hand stopped.

"I'll go take a look."

There was already a circle of people surrounding the door of the supply and marketing cooperative.

The braised food counter was closed, and Director Wang was standing next to it, his face ashen.

When he saw Lin Guoqiang, he immediately asked: "Boss Lin, what's going on? Three people went to the hospital after eating your braised pork!"

Lin Guoqiang was not in a hurry to defend himself. He walked to the counter, lifted the gauze, looked at the marinade, and smelled it.

Then he picked up a piece of braised dried tofu, broke it open, and looked at the cross section carefully.

"Director Wang, this stew is not right."

"What's wrong?"

"My braised food is bright red in color and is made from fried sugar. This one is dark in color and has a strange smell."

Lin Guoqiang handed him the dried beans and said, "Smell it."

Director Wang took it and smelled it, his expression changed.

It does have an indescribable taste, quite sour, not like normal braised food.

"This batch of goods is not from me."

Lin Guoqiang looked at Director Wang, "I ask Zhao Zhijun to deliver the goods every morning. I have a list of how much to deliver and how much to sell.

Today's order is here."

He took out a piece of paper from his pocket and it read: Forty braised pig trotters, sixty braised dried beans, and thirty braised chicken legs.

The quantity of braised food on the counter is not right.

There are several more things.

"Someone mixed something into my goods."

Lin Guoqiang's voice was not loud, but everyone around him heard it.

Sweat started to fall on Director Wang's forehead.

Someone mixed something into the counter of the supply and marketing cooperative. This is a serious matter.

"Call the police." Lin Guoqiang said.

Liu Qiang led the team here.

Three people, wearing police uniforms, surrounded the counter and took away all the remaining braised food samples.

There were more and more people watching, and there was a lot of discussion.

The investigation went faster than expected.

The results came out from the health center. The three people had food poisoning caused by eating spoiled food. The problem lay in a batch of braised dried beans.

There were a few pieces in that batch of braised dried beans that were obviously sticky and smelled rancid, which was completely different from the braised beans that Lin Guoqiang normally supplied.

Who put it?

Liu Qiang asked everyone who had contacted the counter that day.

Salesperson, porter, cleaner.

At the end of the question, the salesman Lao Zhou said hesitantly that Deputy Director Ma had been here in the morning.
